an3.50:1.1: Tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhim pi chindati nillopam pi harati ekāgārikam pi karoti paripanthe pi tiṭṭhati.
an3.50:1.3: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro visamanissito ca hoti gahaṇanissito ca hoti balavanissito ca hoti.
an3.50:1.4: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mahācoro visamanissito hoti?
an3.50:1.5: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro nadīviduggaṃ vā nissito hoti pabbatavisamaṃ vā.
an3.50:1.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mahācoro visamanissito hoti.
an3.50:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mahācoro gahaṇanissito hoti?
an3.50:2.2: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro tiṇagahaṇaṃ vā nissito hoti rukkhagahaṇaṃ vā gedhaṃ vā mahāvanasaṇḍaṃ vā.
an3.50:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mahācoro gahaṇa-nissito hoti.
an3.50:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave mahācoro balavanissito hoti?
an3.50:3.2: Idha bhikkhave mahācoro rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nissito hoti,
an3.50:3.4: Sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati ime me rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantī ti.
an3.50:3.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha tyāssa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
an3.50:3.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave mahācoro balavanissito hoti.
an3.50:3.7: Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhim pi chindati nillopam pi harati ekāgārikam pi karoti paripanthe pi tiṭṭhati. 2.
an3.50:4.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an3.50:4.3: Idha bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu visamanissito ca hoti gahaṇanissito ca balavanissito ca.
an3.50:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu visamanissito hoti?
an3.50:5.2: Idha bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu visamena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti visamena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti visamena manokammena samannāgato hoti.
an3.50:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu visamanissito hoti.
an3.50:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu gahaṇanissito hoti?
an3.50:6.2: Idha bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti.
an3.50:6.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu gahaṇanissito hoti.
an3.50:7.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu balavanissito hoti?
an3.50:7.2: Idha bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nissito hoti,
an3.50:7.4: Sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati ime me rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantī ti.
an3.50:7.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha tyāssa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
an3.50:7.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave pāpabhikkhu balavanissito hoti.
an3.50:7.7: Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavatī ti.
